name: filetree-coverage
description: Passive coverage map for AI-assisted document review (map a folder, work normally, see which files each answer listed, searched, opened or named, per question and cumulatively) plus a document chronology skill that says which charter, IRA, ROFR, voting agreement or plan is operative today, which amendments layer onto it, and what an amended-and-restated version superseded. Records tool calls; dictates nothing about the search. Every output is a draft for attorney review.
